title: Unreal Engine 5.9: What We Found in the Code | Unreal News Episode 2
author: Evening-Crab4100
selftext:
The Unreal Engine 5.9 code is already on Epic's GitHub. We found Unreal games running in a web browser, 20 more AI toolsets (including one for Blueprints), NVIDIA's Kimodo text-to-motion in Sequencer, and Epic's own Gaussian splat plugin. Full breakdown: Unreal News Episode 2.
